# Production Planning Model — Version 2 (Mathematical Formulation)

**Status:** v2 — formal LP formulation derived from `model_v1.md` (purpose, data, and decision semantics unchanged)
**Date:** 2026-10-17
**Model type:** Linear program (LP), continuous variables, single week

---

## 1. Decision Variables

| Variable | Meaning | Units |
|----------|---------|-------|
| xA | Number of units of product A produced per week | units/week |
| xB | Number of units of product B produced per week | units/week |

Domain: xA ≥ 0, xB ≥ 0 (production quantities cannot be negative).
Per v1's divisibility assumption, xA and xB are continuous (fractional units allowed).

## 2. Objective Function

Maximize total weekly profit:

    maximize  Z = 40·xA + 50·xB        [USD/week]

Unit check: 40 USD/unit × xA units/week + 50 USD/unit × xB units/week → USD/week. ✔

## 3. Constraints

### 3.1 Machine-time capacity

Total machine hours consumed per week must not exceed available capacity:

    2·xA + 1·xB ≤ 100        [hours/week]

Unit check: 2 h/unit × xA units/week + 1 h/unit × xB units/week = h/week ≤ 100 h/week. ✔

### 3.2 Labor capacity

Total labor hours consumed per week must not exceed available capacity:

    1·xA + 3·xB ≤ 90         [hours/week]

Unit check: 1 h/unit × xA units/week + 3 h/unit × xB units/week = h/week ≤ 90 h/week. ✔

### 3.3 Nonnegativity

    xA ≥ 0,  xB ≥ 0          [units/week]

## 4. Complete Model (compact form)

    maximize    Z = 40·xA + 50·xB          [USD/week]

    subject to  2·xA + 1·xB ≤ 100          [machine hours/week]
                1·xA + 3·xB ≤ 90           [labor hours/week]
                xA, xB ≥ 0                 [units/week]

## 5. Standard (Matrix) Form

Equivalent formulation for simplex-style solution methods:

    maximize    cᵀx
    subject to  Ax ≤ b,  x ≥ 0

with

    x = [xA, xB]ᵀ              [units/week]
    c = [40, 50]ᵀ              [USD/unit]
    A = [ 2   1 ]              [hours/unit]
        [ 1   3 ]
    b = [100, 90]ᵀ             [hours/week]

## 6. Traceability to v1

| v1 element (words)                    | v2 formalization        |
|---------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| Units of A/B produced per week        | xA, xB (units/week)     |
| Weekly profit objective               | max 40·xA + 50·xB       |
| Machine capacity limit (100 h)        | 2·xA + 1·xB ≤ 100       |
| Labor capacity limit (90 h)           | 1·xA + 3·xB ≤ 90        |
| No negative production                | xA, xB ≥ 0              |

All coefficients are constants (deterministic, per v1 assumptions). No integrality, demand, or inventory constraints — those remain out of scope as in v1.
